name: Enterprise Identity API
description: Standard identity and entitlement lookups, used whenever a pattern needs to know who a user is and what they're allowed to see.

name: Document Store API
description: Versioned storage and retrieval for source documents, used as the backing store behind document-heavy and retrieval patterns.

name: Enterprise Observability Platform
description: Central trace, cost, latency and token logging for AI workloads, with a PHI-safe redaction profile available.

name: Enterprise Audit Log Platform
description: Subject-traceable, tamper-evident audit logging with configurable retention, used for regulated access and action trails.
